overloads.semanticRole: The METHOD Get path command returns the full internal pathname of a method.

jointConstraints.rule: Which of aTable/objectName/formObjectName are required depends on methodType: Path project form needs objectName (form name) and optionally formObjectName (form object name); Path table form needs aTable, objectName (form name), and optionally formObjectName (form object name); Path database method needs objectName (database method name); Path project method needs objectName (method name); Path trigger needs aTable; Path class needs objectName (class name).

constraints: methodType accepts one of the documented "Design Object Access" theme constants: Path project method (1), Path database method (2), Path project form (4), Path trigger (8), Path table form (16), Path class (32), Path volatile method (128).
The command does not check whether the method actually exists; an error is generated only when an invalid database method name is passed with Path database method.
